Saloon,Ⓒs.Ⓓ(suprasADita-)SAlA, kozWaH.

Salt,Ⓒs.ⒹlavaRaM; (fig.) piMqaH; saPalIkftaBartf-piMqaH (M. 5) ‘who showed that he had not eaten his masterʼs s(alt) in vain’; ‘rock-s(alt)’ sEMDavaH-vaM, SItaSivaM; See under Rock; ‘sea-s(alt)’ akzI(kzi)vaM, vaSi(si)raM; ‘black s(alt)’ pAkyaH, biqaM; kzAraM; ‘sambhar s(alt)’ rOmakaM, vasakaM; ‘sochal s(alt)’ sOvarcalaH, akzaM, rucakaM; ‘s(alt)-pan’ lavaRakzetraM; ‘s(alt)-petre’ yavajaH, yavakzAraH, pAkyaH; yavAgrajaH.

Salubrious,Ⓒa.Ⓓhita-svAsTya-kara (rI f.), ArogyAvaha, paTya, anAmayakara, kzemya, puzwida, hita.

 2 Salutary, q. v.

Salutary,Ⓒa.Ⓓhita, hita-kalyARa-kara (rI f.), -Avaha, upakArin, Sreyaskara, SuBaMkara.

Ⓝ[Salut]er,Ⓒs.ⒹaBivAdakaH, aBi-vaMdakaH.
Salvage,Ⓒs.ⒹsaM-, udDftaM; udDAraH, nistaraRaM.

Salvation,Ⓒs.ⒹtAraRaM, udDAraH, mukti f., mokzaH, nistAraH, pApamuktiH, UrDva-parama-gati f.

Salve,Ⓒs.ⒹaMjanaM, pra-anu-lepaH, upadehaH.
